title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Decorations that stay on their line
summary: Press Enter above an inline color swatch or a highlighted forced unwrap, and every decoration below the caret was repainted one line too high. Both providers now move the paint, not just the cache key.

highlights.title: Swatches Stay On Their Line
highlights.description: Adding or removing a line above a hex color swatch no longer repaints it one line off. Measured on a real project: 882 swatches across 138 files, every one of them reachable by a single keystroke.

highlights.title: Unwrap Highlight Follows Its Line
highlights.description: The forced unwrap highlight moves with its line, and so do the raw string and comment block oracles behind it, so a block opened or closed right after an edit is seen again.

highlights.title: A Deleted Triple Quote Is Seen
highlights.description: Color swatches now notice when the triple quote that opened a raw string is deleted, instead of staying painted inside it. The forced unwrap highlight got that memory in 1.42.193.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: A hex color swatch and a forced unwrap highlight now repaint on the line they belong to after a keystroke adds or removes a line above them.
The per line oracles that read raw strings and comment blocks move with the lines, so a boundary deleted after an edit still triggers a rebuild.
Deleting the triple quote that opened a raw string now clears the swatches it was hiding.
